text:
Maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands — dropping this thread for any follow-up Qs we didn’t get to about reviews/leveling/promos/comp/benefits. Please ping here and we’ll respond by EOD tomorrow.
Aj (Eng Manager): Quick one — when will managers get the final calibration spreadsheet?
Maria (People Ops): @Aj we’ll publish the manager calibration sheet in the docs folder by Monday morning (link will be posted here). Managers should not share it outside the calibration group.
Sam (IC): Curious about timeline: if someone gets approved in calibration, when does the compensation change hit payroll?
Taylor (Finance): Typically changes are processed the next payroll cycle after the comp ops run — expect the increase to show up within 4–6 weeks post-approval, depending on payroll cutoffs.
Devon (Recruiting): For new hires whose offers are already extended and then comp bands change — do we re-open offers or keep original?
Maria (People Ops): We’ll honor the original offers for candidates with signed offers. If an offer is unsigned and we shift bands, recruiting will get guidance on whether to re-offer at new band.
Sam (IC): Will there be any retroactive adjustments for people affected by the recent band refresh?
Taylor (Finance): Retro adjustments are case-by-case. We’re prioritizing folks flagged during calibration. If affected, you’ll see a separate retro payment line item; we’ll notify managers when those are scheduled.
Aj (Eng Manager): Is there a manager office hours session this week for calibration questions?
Maria (People Ops): Yes — office hours scheduled Thursday 10:30–11:30 PT. Drop tricky cases in this thread or bring them to the session.
Sam (IC): Can ICs see the rubric used for leveling decisions? Would help for growth plans.
Maria (People Ops): The leveling rubric is public in the handbook. We’ll post a short TL;DR doc with examples after calibration so ICs can see what changed.
Devon (Recruiting): Any update on promo nomination cadence — do we still do mid-year exceptions?
Maria (People Ops): Core promo window stays annual, but exceptions are allowed for exceptional cases; managers need to file the expedited nomination form (link to be shared).
Sam (IC): Benefits Q — 401k match timeline question from someone in my team.
Taylor (Finance): 401k match policy hasn’t changed. Match is processed each pay period; vesting unchanged. If someone’s contribution changed mid-cycle we can look up specifics — ask @Maria and I’ll follow up.
hr-bot: New doc uploaded: https://internal.docs/redwood/handbook/leveling-rubric-v2 — uploaded by Maria (People Ops)
Maria (People Ops): Posting links promised: manager calibration sheet (internal only): https://internal.docs/redwood/cals/manager-calibration-2026, expedited nomination form: https://internal.docs/redwood/forms/expedite-promo, office hours calendar invite.
Aj (Eng Manager): Thanks — I’ll pull my slate together and bring 3 edge cases to Thu office hours.
Sam (IC): Appreciate the clarity. If anything major shifts after calibration, can leadership do a short follow-up all-hands?
Maria (People Ops): Absolutely — if there are material policy changes we’ll do a follow-up comms + short Q&A. Otherwise expect manager-level comms and updated handbook pages.
Taylor (Finance): FYI — anyone expecting retro pay should get a manager DM this week confirming amounts.
Devon (Recruiting): Noted — recruiting will hold offers until we get final band confirmations early next week.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have confidential cases, DM me or use the private form. We’ll update this thread after Thursday office hours with any clarifications. :white_check_mark:
